outcome.answer: The closest match is [2], which addresses dispatch optimization for instant delivery platforms where couriers may serve multiple platforms and each platform only observes its own orders and courier interactions. [2] uses partially observable multi-agent reinforcement learning with platform-local observations, which fits the “without seeing all their data” part. [1] is also related to driver dispatch on ride-sharing platforms, but it assumes a centralized setting rather than partial observability across several apps.
